title: Set up the Sass tool
summary: Sass is a tool that turns a style recipe into CSS.
introduction: Sass is a tool that turns a style recipe into CSS. Your task: Find the version number printed by the Sass tool.
learningObjectives: Find the version number printed by the Sass tool.
Explain the example for set up the sass tool

blocks.text: Sass is a tool that turns a style recipe into CSS. The browser reads the CSS file, so it does not need to understand the Sass recipe.
Use Dart Sass on your computer. Install Node.js first, with help if needed. Save SCSS examples as lesson.scss and run npx sass lesson.scss lesson.css. This site does not compile Sass.
Read the code step by step

items: The install command adds Sass to this project, not to the browser.
The version command is a small check that the installed tool can start.

blocks.text: The first command adds Sass to a local project. The second prints its version number.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Run these commands in a project folder. A .scss file is not a CSS file that a browser can read directly.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Find the version number printed by the Sass tool.
